[Council File 26-1212]
Motion (McOsker – Hutt) relative to the feasibility of utilizing Municipal Improvement Corporation of Los Angeles (MICLA) financing or other funding mechanisms to support the capital construction and ongoing operations of the proposed Jordan Downs Neighborhood Recreation Center, and related matters.

None submitted

outcome.text: Council adopted item forthwith (Sep 22, 2026); Council action final
